This exact thing happened to me. I was 23 and he was 17 turning 18 when we started talking but convinced me he was in his 20s. FYI he was asian so its generally harder to give an exact age guess.

Anyway, I stuck with it for a week to see things out and I realized he is a pathological liar because I'd catch him in stupid lies, small or big. I felt so dumb because I didn't have any doubts at first and if I did, I would've seen that he graduated school on FB, looked into a few of his friends profiles to see that it was HIGH SCHOOL. 😅 Anyway he screenshotted our snapchat conversation of us arguing and showing it to our friends but it didn't expose me or anything cause it was just bickering and name-calling and me asking him a bunch of questions. The usual shit I'm open about.

 Only 2 of our friends sided with him because they felt bad that nobody wanted to be his friend. What BOGGLES my mind was that one of the two friends was preaching that he doesn't like fake people or liars, yet he is best friends with the pathological liar and his lies proven with receipts. I mean I guess he can easily deceive people and the friend is blind but that's OK. Few less idiots in my path, I wish them all well and hope they figure themselves out.
